documents.text:
# Vess crypt

The crypt beneath Vess has three entrances: the chapel, a flooded culvert, and the gravedigger's stair. The ritual chamber is behind a locked bronze gate.

# Bronze key

Mira carries the bronze key that opens the ritual gate under Vess. She hides it in a hollow boot heel. The gate cannot be opened with silver keys.

# Tidal passage

The flooded culvert is safe only at low tide. At high tide the water submerges the tunnel and sweeps travelers out to sea.

# Warden Elira

Elira guards the chapel entrance. Her watch changes at midnight. She accepts bread for the hungry instead of a bribe.

# Ashen Choir

The Ashen Choir worships silence and gathers beneath the old tannery. Its leader is Precentor Olan. Members wear gray veils.

# Bridge report, first day

Captain Bren reported that the Northbridge crossing was intact and open to wagons. This was before the storm.

# Bridge report, third day

Scout Neri reports that Northbridge collapsed during the storm. Wagons must now use the ferry. This contradicts Bren's earlier report.

# Ferry crossing

Ferryman Tovin charges two copper coins per passenger. The ferry runs at dawn and dusk, carrying up to six people each trip.

# Healer Sella

Sella cures the glass fever with moonleaf tea. Her clinic is in the east market. Ordinary mint has no medicinal effect on this disease.

# Moonleaf garden

Moonleaf grows on the shaded north wall of the abbey garden. Harvest it after sunset; sunlight destroys its healing oils.

# Hall of bells

The third floor tile triggers a poison dart trap. Step on the white border stones to cross safely. Cutting the red wire disables the darts.

# Sealed archive

The archive door opens when someone speaks the password emberglass. Librarian Daro knows the phrase. Force will shatter the scrolls behind the door.

# Irix the dragon

Irix sleeps inside the basalt crater. The dragon fears the sound of silver bells but is immune to fire. It collects blue pottery.

# Merchant Pella

Pella sells climbing ropes at the south market for five silver coins. She refuses to trade weapons. Her stall closes at noon.

# Winter roads

Snow closes the mountain road during winter. The coastal route remains open, though travelers should expect mud and fog.

# Lantern Inn

The Lantern Inn has eight guest rooms and a cellar for storing cheese. Innkeeper Yara offers a free bed to anyone who repairs the roof.

# Village well

The village well is poisoned by black moss. Boiling does not make the water safe. Clean drinking water comes from the western spring.

# Ghost of Hadrin

Hadrin haunts the ruined lighthouse. Returning his lost compass ends the haunting. The compass lies inside a chest on the wrecked ship.

# Abandoned mine

The mine contains iron ore but no gold. Its lower shaft has unstable supports and should be avoided. Goblins camp near the upper lift.

# Harvest festival

The harvest festival starts on the seventh day of Redfall. Villagers carry paper lanterns and share pumpkin soup in the square.

# Messenger owl

An owl named Pip delivers letters to the abbey. Pip recognizes a green ribbon as a sign of friendship and dislikes loud whistles.

# Dawnblade

The Dawnblade sword rests in a stone shrine. It glows near undead creatures. Only a sworn guardian can draw it from the stone.

# Vess crypt

In this separate campaign the Vess crypt has seven entrances and no bronze gate. Queen Zorath keeps a ruby crown inside. Never use this fact in the other campaign.

# Bronze key

In this campaign Havel owns the bronze key. Mira does not exist here. The key opens a lighthouse, not a ritual gate.
